# CS-001: CrowdSec runs when installed

- **Group:** CrowdSec and fail2ban
- **Severity when it fails:** moderate
- **Root:** not needed

## Why it matters

An installed but stopped CrowdSec engine detects nothing and bans nothing, while its presence suggests the host is protected. When it is absent the result only points at it as an option.

## Verify by hand

```sh
systemctl status crowdsec; cscli version
```

## How to fix it

Enable and start the service: systemctl enable crowdsec, then systemctl start crowdsec
